# Sponsored ad campaigns and serving

> Sellers create pay-per-click ad campaigns, shoppers get up to three sponsored listings per category, and clicks flow through a signed redirect link while daily spend is counted in Redis.

_Part of [domain/marketing](../../units/domain/marketing.md)_

Everything lives in the `marketing` domain. [`AdsController`](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md) has three routes and hands the work to [`AdsService`](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md). Two Nest modules wire it up: [`AdsModule`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) for the API side (controller, service, Kafka producer) and [`AdsWorkerModule`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) for the worker side (click aggregation and billing jobs, using `ClickHouse` and the ledger). First, a seller creates a campaign with `POST /shops/:shopId/ads/campaigns`. It needs the `products.write` permission on that shop. The body carries the product, a category, the price per click in cents and a daily budget in cents (at least 100). `createCampaign` inserts an `AdCampaign` row, but only if the product really belongs to that shop. If it doesn't, nothing is inserted. Next, a shopper (even an anonymous one) calls `GET /ads/sponsored?category=...`. `sponsored` loads up to 10 `ACTIVE` campaigns in that category whose product is in stock, ordered by highest price per click. It then reads each campaign's spend for today from Redis in one `MGET` call. It drops campaigns that would go over budget with one more click and keeps the top 3. Each result gets a signed, 30-minute click link built with [`signClick`](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md). When the shopper clicks, `GET /ads/click/:token` calls `click`. Token checks, dedupe, fraud limits and Kafka publishing are covered in [Ad click tokens and fraud checks](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md). For valid clicks, the campaign's price per click is added to its daily Redis spend counter, which is what `sponsored` reads next time. Billing from the clicks happens later, see [Aggregating and billing ad clicks](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md).

**Look at:** [`AdsController` in ads.controller.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/api/ads.controller.ts#L19) · [`AdsService` in ads.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/ads.service.ts#L28) · [`AdsWorkerModule` in ads.module.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/ads.module.ts#L18) · [index.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/index.ts)

## Pieces

- Creating an ad campaign for a shop's product: `createCampaign` inserts an `AdCampaign` row with category, price per click and daily budget, only if the product belongs to the shop.
- [Choosing which sponsored listings to show](sponsored-slot-selection.md): `sponsored` picks the highest-paying active campaigns that still have budget today and returns up to 3 with signed click links.
- [Daily campaign spend counter in Redis](daily-spend-counter.md): A Redis counter per campaign and day, raised by the price per click on each valid click and expiring after two days.
- API module and worker module wiring: [`AdsModule`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) serves the endpoints; [`AdsWorkerModule`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) hosts [`ClickAggregator`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) and [`AdBillingJobs`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) for the worker app.
- [Click redirect and fraud filtering](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md): The click endpoint always redirects and records whether the click counts.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `AdCampaign` | Campaigns are inserted by `createCampaign` and read by `sponsored` (status, category, price per click, daily budget). |
| database | `Product` | Checked on campaign creation (must belong to the shop) and joined in `sponsored` for the title and stock (`quantity > 0`). |
| cache | `adspend:{campaignId}:YYYY-MM-DD` | Approximate daily spend in cents. Read with `MGET` when serving and incremented on valid clicks. Expires after 2 days. |
| queue | `ads.clicks` | Kafka topic that click records are published to from `click`. |

## Also relies on

- [Ad click tokens and fraud checks](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md): Handles the click token check, dedupe, per-IP limits and Kafka publish behind `GET /ads/click/:token`.
- [Aggregating and billing ad clicks](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md): Aggregates the published clicks and bills campaigns in the worker module.

## Watch out

- The spend check in `sponsored` is approximate. It uses Redis click counters, not billed amounts, so a campaign can be slightly over or under its budget until billing runs.
- Campaign creation returns no error if the product isn't in the shop. The insert simply selects zero rows.
- The spend counter is only raised for valid clicks, and the day key uses UTC dates.
- The click endpoint always redirects, even for bad tokens (to `/`) or fraud-filtered clicks, and it sends `no-store` so every click reaches the server.
